svg.title: Test a mailbox report before using a live service
svg.desc: The practice file contains different kinds of mailboxes. The report should keep only the kinds requested. Input. Read the made-up rows in the CSV file. Rule. Keep user and shared mailboxes. Leave out other types. Verify. Open the report and compare its addresses and types with the expected rows.
